This style LoRA is based on the screen-print poster work of Shepard Fairey. It gives images his propaganda-poster look: a limited palette of red, cream, black and teal, bold stencil-style portraits, halftone dots, and aged paper textures with a slightly distressed print finish. Many training images use ornamental frames, radiating sunbursts, stylised lotus and floral motifs, and symmetrical layouts, so the LoRA often adds decorative borders and poster-style composition. It works well for portraits, and it also gives landscapes, cityscapes and still-life scenes a printed, graphic finish.

This one is a crazy beast and it will eat you alive if you are not careful. I strongly suggest downloading images as workflows and prompts are stored inside

title: Spritely Map Painter [LORA/Qwen]
description:
Spritely Map Painter paints isometric pixel-art game maps with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. It comes in three versions: Grow, Layout Guide and Repaint. The images on this page show the input canvas next to the result.

Grow v1. Fill part of your map with magenta and Map Painter paints more of the map into that space. It can also paint a whole new level in the style of a picture you provide.

Layout Guide v1. This version also grows maps, and you can draw a flat colour plan inside the magenta area. Grey is floor, orange is stairs, yellow is a ladder, and Map Painter paints the level to match the plan.

Repaint v1. Paint over part of a map with the same flat colours, and Map Painter redraws only that part. Everything outside the paint stays the same. It can also repaint a whole picture from a plan.

V4

Version 4 is based on version 3, but I have reworked the background, details, and lighting.

Stylistically, it moves away from the standard anime aesthetic, thanks in part to a much higher level of detail.

Recommended for those who want to create rich, vibrant images. It works excellently in combination with other LoRAs and pairs well with most checkpoints.

POSITIVE PROMPT: anime screencap, anime coloring

NEGATIVE PROMPT: 3D, realistic

V3

A completely new model that is very different from V1 and V2. The dataset was created entirely by me, and the images in it are in very high resolution. Many popular characters were used in the creation, so the faces and body anatomy had to be as close as possible to what we see in anime.

This version has much more contrast, subtle contours, and is perfect for both SFW and NSFW images.

The goal was to create lora that would blend well

title: Carys [LORA/Krea 2]
description:
Carys is trained from 100% generated images! Any likeness to person(s) living or dead is as coincidental as finding your own doppelganger out there - could happen, not intentional. She has been trained with a set of character prompts AND a custom LoRA stack (including my personal, never released, Faye model).

Carys: The Girl Next Door

Carys is the older sister of Faye. She is roughly 35 years old and an aspiring MILF! She doesn't have a huge backstory, other than I wanted to share a character LoRA. She is trained with a soft-athletic build, a blonde bob, flat chest, but should have some flexibility to take body and hair direction.
